# Investment Memo Template

> Use this template as the structural backbone for all investment memoranda. Adapt section depth to the audience and deal stage identified in Checkpoint A.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

> **Write this section LAST. Position it FIRST.** One page maximum.

**Company/Asset:** [Name]
**Transaction Type:** [Platform acquisition / Add-on / Growth investment / etc.]
**Deal Size:** [Enterprise Value: $___M | Equity Check: $___M]
**Date:** [IC Date or Draft Date]
**Prepared By:** [Analyst / Associate / Team]

### Recommendation

> State clearly: **Invest**, **Pass**, or **Requires Additional Diligence**. No hedging.

[One sentence recommendation with conditions if applicable.]

### Investment Highlights

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Thesis (one-line) | [Concise statement of why this investment generates returns] |
| Expected Return | [IRR: __% / MOIC: __x (PE) or Upside: __% to price target (public)] |
| Entry Valuation | [EV/EBITDA: __x | EV/Revenue: __x | other relevant metric] |
| Key Risk | [Single most significant risk in one sentence] |
| Source of Edge | [Why this opportunity exists and why we capture it] |
| Timeline | [Expected close date, hold period, or catalyst timeline] |

---

## 2. Company / Asset Overview

### Business Description

[2-3 paragraphs covering: what the company does, how it makes money, its market position, and its operating history. Include founding date, headquarters, employee count, and ownership structure.]
